The Greek restaurants in Portland are excellent and this place is no exception. The Mediterranean-inspired cuisine is simply superb. The starter came (Small $8); a simple cucumber and tomato salad ($10). Our waiter brought the chicken with a side of marinated, fresh garlic scapes. We both ate all of them, and the dressing was delicious. I could make everything better but this was by far the best. Just the right amount of freshness. Now, the main course followed. The couscous was so sweet - a perfect summer side dish - I could have ate whole bunches! The next item was the fish pot pie! It was delicious - just like the photos. It was so tasty! When re-roasted, it is tender and moist. I've been searching for the recipe for this all throughout the summer and this is the PERFECT combination of vegetables. We then ate an unsweetened, light berry cocktail made from a combination of sparkling water and vodka. It was lovely and didn't quite leave my mouth. The flaky and soft baklava with the honey-drenched semolina cake served on a warm Turkish bread. It tasted like the sugar on my shortbread dough actually came off. They were so good! We all had to share. We also ordered the Amos - Greek wine - house wine ($3 each). After all this, we just had to re-check out the bar. This is the kind of place where you feel right at home in any situation - I also felt that our server was the perfect mix of sweet and spicy. And a good reason to go to a great restaurant. If you're nearby - please stop by and visit. My friends & I will be back.
